steps.why: cc installed on the core: C and C++ compile and run.
steps.script: echo '#include <stdio.h>' > /tmp/hello.c && echo 'int main(void) { puts("HELLO"); return 0; }' >> /tmp/hello.c && cc /tmp/hello.c -o /tmp/hello && test "$(/tmp/hello)" = HELLO
echo '#include <iostream>' > /tmp/hello.cpp && echo 'int main() { std::cout << 6 * 7; }' >> /tmp/hello.cpp && c++ /tmp/hello.cpp -o /tmp/hello++ && test "$(/tmp/hello++)" = 42

echo '#include <dolly/http.h>' > /tmp/http.c && echo 'int main(void) { dolly_http_response response = {0}; dolly_http_request request = {.method = "GET", .url = "https://example.invalid/", .headers = ""}; return dolly_http_perform(&request, &response) != 0; }' >> /tmp/http.c && cc /tmp/http.c -o /tmp/http

steps.why: The image declares no http@0: a program linked with the HTTP client is refused before it runs (126; had it run, its failed request would be 1).
